name: "Mushteshir"
desc: The first "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" ever to remain upon the lunar surface. It is said to be a prototype built by the dragon researcher Maagees-Geti. It was originally created as a cooperative mechanism to aid in lunar research. But as time passed, it was entrusted with power and responsibilities far beyond the purpose for which it had first been designed. The one who made it has long since forgotten the name "Mushteshir." Yet the machine still remembers the duty bound to that name: to be a guide, a pioneer, and an eternal sentinel watching over the stars that have yet to be reached.
